name: Teia Profiles Contract
description: On-chain registry of Teia user profiles, keyed by the user's address: every address has at most one profile and writes it itself with set_profile. Each profile stores its current IPFS/Arweave CID, an optional unique handle, a moderated flag and a version counter (version_count). The version history itself is NOT stored on-chain: every CID change emits a complete version record (tag profile_created for a new profile, profile_updated for a new version, each carrying the address, CID, version number and timestamp), from which indexers reconstruct the full append-only history. The profile's display name, description, avatar, links and artist card configuration live off-chain in the profile's CID content. A profile can claim one unique handle (claim_handle) that resolves to its address through the handles big_map and the get_handle_owner view; a handle is 1 to 32 characters from a-z, 0-9, underscore and hyphen, so handles cannot differ only by case and can never be mistaken for a Tezos address. Claiming a new handle releases the previous one, and release_handle gives a handle up. set_profile charges profile_fee and claim_handle charges handle_fee; both default to 0 and are forwarded to the fee recipient. Moderators and linked multisig users have two moderation powers: flagging a profile as moderated (set_profile_moderated), which the owner cannot lift, and blocking a handle (set_handle_blocked), which releases it from its current owner and prevents anyone from claiming it; handles reserved for front end routes are blocked at origination. Multisig governance covers pause, the linked multisig/moderator addresses, the per-action fees, the fee recipient and contract metadata updates; governance proposals require a minimum number of votes and expire after a configurable time, both fetched from the linked multisig contract.

expansion.string: The caller is not authorized to perform this action
No profile exists for the given address
The operation does not accept tez transfers
The provided tez amount does not match the required profile_fee for set_profile or handle_fee for claim_handle
A handle must be 1 to 32 characters from a-z, 0-9, underscore and hyphen
The handle is blocked and cannot be claimed
The caller's profile has no handle to release
The given governance proposal id does not exist
The governance proposal has already been executed and cannot be voted on or executed again
The governance proposal did not receive enough positive votes to be executed
The governance proposal has expired and can no longer be voted on or executed
Failed to call the is_user view on the linked multisig contract
Failed to call the is_moderator view on the linked moderator contract
Failed to call the get_minimum_votes view on the linked multisig contract
Failed to call the get_expiration_time view on the linked multisig contract
